metadata.title: How to Check Snapshot Dates in VaultXT | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
In VaultXT’s Snapshots panel, check the creation date and time shown for each entry before choosing Restore.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator screenshot with an original demonstration document and seeded snapshots. No taps, snapshot creation, preview of older document contents, restoration, or speed demonstration is shown. The green border is part of the original capture.

Explore VaultXT for Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.vaultxt
